# Printed-page font fixtures

`p1.ttf`, `p2.ttf`, `p100.ttf`, `p106.ttf`, and `p604.ttf` are unchanged KFGQPC QPC V2 fonts from the
approved source recorded in `assets/quran/qpc_v2/SOURCE.md`. Downloaded on
2026-11-17 from `https://static.qurancdn.com/fonts/quran/hafs/v2/ttf/`.
The page tests verify byte length and SHA-256 against the bundled approved
manifest before registering each font. No font or Quran glyph has been edited.

These fixtures keep the printed-page tests offline and cover a centered opening
page, an adjacent-page idle preparation, a justified page, a surah title and
basmala, and repeated basmala semantics.
Publisher/distribution terms and the owner's existing license follow-up are
documented in the source record above.
